summary: Prisme Analytics is a privacy-focused web analytics platform built on top of Grafana. It allows self-hosters to collect and visualise visitor metrics while maintaining control over their data.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you already use Grafana for monitoring and want a unified dashboard for your web analytics.
watchOut: The project has a low maintenance health score and modest community adoption, indicating a higher risk of abandonment or lacking support.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based deployment, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
